'''Yolanda García''' (born 18 January 1971) is a Spanish [[taekwondo]] practitioner, born in [[Andorra]]. She won a silver medal in heavyweight at the [[1995 World Taekwondo Championships]], and a gold medal at the 1994 [[European Taekwondo Championships]].<ref name=taekwondodata>{{cite web |url=https://www.taekwondodata.com/yolanda-garcia.a1pm.html
|title=García, Yolanda |website=taekwondodata.com 
|access-date=10 October 2019}}</ref>
